_about: HPN ATC speech-to-text words (GitHub #233; sizeup/atc.py). 'phrases': Amazon Transcribe's custom vocabulary for the airband channels (pushed as sizeup-atc with the PCFD one, Settings > Radios > Vocabulary > Push): written as said on the air, no digits (runway 'one six', not '16'), at most 256 characters each. 'prompt': whisper's prompt for an airband channel when it runs on the station's model; the callsigns of the aircraft nearest HPN (the Aircraft layer) are added after it. From shortfinal's stt_prompt.py (airport_vocabulary, PHRASES) and data/khpn_operators.csv (who actually flies at HPN; telephony from FAA JO 7340.2), with the fire department's words. Taxiways: data/airport/khpn_surface.geojson (OpenStreetMap).
prompt: Westchester Tower, Westchester Ground, New York Approach. Runway one six, runway three four, runway one one, runway two niner. Taxiway alfa, bravo, charlie, delta, echo, foxtrot, golf, hotel, juliett, kilo. Cleared to land, cleared for takeoff, line up and wait, hold short, go around, souls on board, fuel remaining, declaring an emergency, roll the trucks.
